query:
-- Détails des molécules Geosmin, Indole, Vanilline, Pyrazine
SELECT id, name, olfactiveProfile, family FROM molecules 
WHERE name LIKE '%geosmin%' 
   OR name LIKE '%indole%' 
   OR name LIKE '%vanillin%' 
   OR name LIKE '%pyrazine%'
ORDER BY name;
